create_reach_environment: create a ReachEnvV0 instance with a MuJoCo model path and target reach range config
setup_reach_environment: setup the reach environment with target reach range, frame skip, and reward weight keys
get_observation_vector: get the observation vector containing qpos, qvel, tip positions, and reach error from the sim
get_observation_dict: get the observation dictionary from a MuJoCo simulator with tip and target site positions
get_reward_dict: get the reward dictionary with reach distance, bonus, penalty, sparse, dense, solved, and done keys
